messages:
maya: Quick thread: proposing a lightweight Network Contracts Registry for Private (VPC/on-prem) so field can see what customers signed and we can tie manifests to guarantees. Also want a "rollback-proof" artifact (signed manifest bundle + preflight report) for audits.

maya: Problem: field repeatedly asks "what did customer agree to" and "can we prove we reverted to X". Registry should store contract level, manifest hash history, and signed preflight artifacts.

arjun: Love it. We should expose an API: GET /tenants/{id}/network-contract and GET /tenants/{id}/manifests which returns signed entries. Also add a small retention policy for historical artifacts (e.g., 90 days by default).

felix: Operational requirements: when applying a manifest we create a rollback-proof bundle: {manifest, preflight-report, signatures}. Store immutably and emit an audit event. For airgapped installs we accept customer-signed bundles and verify signatures before apply.

carla: UX: Console shows the active contract card, last 5 manifests with hashes, and a "download rollback-proof" button that returns the signed bundle. Add a clear badge when tenant has "pin-window" active.

ops-bot: Ticket created: PRD-12034 "Network Contracts Registry + rollback-proof bundles" -> https://go/repo/PRD-12034 :spiral_notepad:

maya: Proposed contract levels: relay (no egress SLA), pin-window (egress pin + lease id), sovereign-peer (peering + signed-manifest requirement). Each entry in registry should reference the controlling RFC and legal addendum if present.

arjun: For upgrade paths: require per-tenant opt-in with a manifest ratchet id. Upgrades create a new immutable manifest record; revert picks the previous record and we log revert_reason. Revert should only be allowed if a signed preflight exists unless tenant has explicitly waived checks.

felix: Telemetry hooks: manifest_apply_latency_ms, rollback_initiated_by, rollback_duration_ms, preflight_verification_status. We'll surface these on Redwood Console.

carla: Acceptance criteria for MVP: API + registry schema, download bundle button, signed-bundle verification on apply, and console card for contract level. Pilot with 2 customers.

maya: Owners: arjun -> API + registry backend; felix -> bundle signer/verifier + telemetry; carla -> console card + download flow; maya -> RFC + pilot outreach.

maya: Timeline: lock MVP scope this week, ship pilot in ~6w. If no objections I'll add acceptance tests to PRD-12034. React with :thumbsup: or objections.

arjun: :+1: starting schema draft

felix: :+1: will prototype signer in spike

carla: :+1: will mock card tomorrow

ops-bot: PRD-12034 labels updated: +contracts-registry +private-deploy +due 2026-06-10

maya: Thanks all, filing RFC and assigning owners.
